# Rahmad Rizki — Full Stack Web Developer & AI Implementation Specialist

> Portfolio of Rahmad Rizki, a full stack web developer based in Central Jakarta,
> Indonesia. He builds backend systems with Node.js and Express and frontends with
> React and Next.js, and works on AI implementation. The site is a single page;
> every section below is an anchor on it.

## Sections

- [About](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#about): skills across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and AI workflow
- [Education](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#education): degrees and hackathon participation
- [Experience](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#experience): work history
- [Certifications](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#certifications): certificates including Microsoft Certified Azure AI Fundamentals
- [Projects](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#projects): selected work, with live and source links
- [Contact](https://rizky-portfolio.pages.dev/#contact): how to reach him

## Projects

- [Barakah Qurban](https://barakah-qurban.vercel.app): landing page for a Qurban cattle provider. Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI. [Source](https://github.com/rizky-rahmad/barakah-qurban)
- [SIKEMAS](https://sikemasbpsdm.web.id): complaint management system for BPSDM Aceh with multi-role RBAC, audit logs, and automated ticket dispatching. React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, JWT, Google OAuth 2.0
